title: Argun’s Shop – Hackney Today (E3) – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – At the new shop (page 8)
lines: Hello. Is this Argun? I used to go to the shop on Mare Street.
Yes, it’s us! We moved here this year.
The company that owns the arches wanted us to leave. They’re going to put bars and restaurants there.
Oh no. Did they offer you another shop?
Yes, on Morning Lane. But nobody walks down that street. We thought we would lose half our customers there.
So you came here instead. Good! If you closed, I wouldn’t know where to print anything.
Don’t worry. We’re right opposite the station now, so lots of people walk past.
Exactly. What can I do for you today?
I need fifty invitations for my daughter’s wedding.
No problem. If you order today, they’ll be ready on Friday.
Perfect. Are you open on Sundays?
No, sorry. We’re open Monday to Saturday, nine to six.
Great. I’ll come back on Saturday to collect them.
